name: Netmend Shots
title: Screenshot beautifier: gradient backgrounds, browser frames and shadows, free in your browser
desc: Turn a plain screenshot into a polished image for X, LinkedIn, Product Hunt or your website: gradient backgrounds, macOS and browser frames, rounded corners, shadows and ready-made sizes. 100% in your browser, no upload. Pro is $19 lifetime.
intro: Drop or paste a screenshot. Pick a background, a window frame and a size for X, LinkedIn, Product Hunt or Instagram, and export a PNG. Nothing is uploaded: the image is drawn on a canvas in this browser.
